title: Error responses are text/plain, not JSON
evidence: main.go:64,70,78,85,114,125,141,151,153,168,175,181,191,193,202,218,228,230,239,259,271 — 21 http.Error() calls; Go's http.Error writes 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' and a bare string body. Only the 6 success paths (main.go:53,91,131,158,208,244) set application/json.
suggestion: Add a writeJSONError(w, code, msg) helper that sets Content-Type: application/json and encodes {"error": msg}, and use it at every http.Error site.

title: Empty GET /books encodes as null instead of []
evidence: main.go:119 declares `var books []Book` (nil slice) and main.go:132 encodes it directly, so an empty collection serialises as `null` rather than `[]`.
suggestion: Initialise as `books := []Book{}` so the empty case marshals to `[]`.

title: ?author= filter has no Go test
evidence: main.go:102-106 implements the filter, but none of the 7 Test* functions in main_test.go exercise it; the only coverage is test_api.sh:29, a shell script `go test` never runs. prompts/neutral.md asks for tests that demonstrate the implementation meets the requirements.
suggestion: Add a TestGetBooksByAuthor that creates two books with distinct authors and asserts GET /books?author=X returns only the match.

title: Tests run against the real ./books.db with no isolation or cleanup
evidence: main_test.go:35,94,130,177,236,314 each call initDB(), which opens the shared file DB at main.go:30 ('./books.db'); no test truncates the table. main_test.go:169 asserts only `len(response) == 0` is false, which residual rows satisfy regardless of the code under test.
suggestion: Parameterise initDB with a DSN and use ':memory:' or a t.TempDir() file per test; assert on the specific book created rather than a non-empty list.

title: Author filter is an unanchored LIKE substring match
evidence: main.go:105-106 builds `WHERE author LIKE ?` with `fmt.Sprintf("%%%s%%", author)`, so ?author=e matches nearly every row and user-supplied % or _ act as wildcards.
suggestion: Use equality (or an explicitly documented prefix match) and escape LIKE metacharacters if substring matching is intended.

title: Sub-path URLs return 400 instead of 404
evidence: main.go:138,165,215 derive the id with strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/books/"), so GET /books/1/reviews yields idStr="1/reviews", strconv.Atoi fails, and the handler returns 400 'Invalid book ID' for a route that does not exist.
suggestion: Reject paths containing a further '/' with 404, or use Go 1.22 pattern routing (GET /books/{id}).

title: Each test re-opens and closes the package-level db handle
evidence: main_test.go:35-36 (and 94-95, 130-131, 177-178, 236-237, 314-315) call initDB() then `defer db.Close()`, repeatedly replacing and closing the global `db` from main.go:24; TestHealthCheck (main_test.go:12) runs with whatever handle state the previous test left behind.
suggestion: Open the test DB once in TestMain and close it there.

title: test_api.sh is not wired into the test suite or the README
evidence: test_api.sh (65 lines, executable) drives the API with curl against a live server on :8080, but README.md's Testing section (README.md:39-45) only documents `go test -v` and never mentions it.
suggestion: Document test_api.sh in the README, or fold its cases into Go tests.

title: Test count exceeds the required minimum
evidence: main_test.go defines 7 Test* functions (TestHealthCheck, TestCreateBook, TestCreateBookWithInvalidData, TestGetBooks, TestGetBookById, TestUpdateBook, TestDeleteBook) against a spec minimum of 3; all SQL uses parameterised queries (main.go:72,104-108,146,185,199,225,236) so no injection surface.
